<thought>The observed isotopic pattern shows a primary peak at m/z 121 with successive peaks spaced ~1 Da apart and decreasing intensities (≈8 % for +1 Da, ≈0.5 % for +2 Da, etc.). This matches the natural 13C isotopic distribution for a molecule containing several carbons and does not display the characteristic patterns of Cl, Br, S, etc. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
